title: Group the source-root session fields into one struct owned by engram_source_roots.rs
outcome: Follow-up from the tm-5gi4 phase 2 round-4 review (Claude note N4). EngramSessionState in engram_host_adapter.rs (already about 6,900 lines) holds four source-root fields: active_turn_source_root, pending_source_root_line, source_root_line_generation and source_root_line_delivery, plus the set_pending_source_root_line helper. Move them into one struct (for example EngramSourceRootSessionState) defined in engram_source_roots.rs, and have EngramSessionState hold that struct as a single field, so the subsystem's state lives next to its logic. Pure move: no behaviour change, and all call sites are updated. Do it after phase 2 lands.
